kind: ad8 actual Native budget failure; exact-entry and array alert validation; unpublished read-wave source regression

nativeActual.important: CI and Desktop workflow success do not satisfy the separate Native<=Web and bundled<=hosted budget gates; no window, PKCE or background work was subtracted. The new source has not been measured in a packaged Native run.

ad8ExactEntry.historicalReadBoundaries: A single known historical trace proves one observed exact flow→vqs.process→workflow.execute parent chain. It does not prove the deployed SDK version, trace mode or universal topology.

realEngineValidation.kind: one pure synthetic SELECT comparing exact new SQL and saved owner SQL; no production table source
realEngineValidation.negative_controls: Old SQL actually failed successful non-root wake/cron and same-trace failed-child cases on the same input; historical linked root+queue remains positive in both versions.
realEngineValidation.duplicate_rows: A deliberate duplicate physical HTTP row produces3distinct identities and4raw excluded rows; they are not conflated.

actualHistoricalReads.caution: The full query did not return all per-source rows. No claim is made that all unknown errors are zero, or that results at different read times are a controlled performance comparison.

offlineValidation.ci_contract: CI verifies exact SQL, materialized fixture, official acceptance script, generated query and result hashes, then strict returned identity sets and counts. It does not execute HogQL or simulate the classification algorithm.
offlineValidation.red_receipt_gate: Before a real-engine receipt existed, the two receipt-dependent tests failed with missing evidence. This is not presented as the semantic red test; the real old/new synthetic query supplies that evidence.
offlineValidation.query_only_entry: The official posthog-alert-acceptance.mjs --query-only child emits the byte-exact already executed synthetic packet without contacting PostHog.

arrayAlert.boundary: Pure synthetic SELECT cases validate actual HogQL semantics; CI verifies the source/fixture/query/result hashes and exact sets without executing a remote query. Full historical query success is not deployed-run production acceptance.

liveDriftAndCompatibility.boundary: The earlier preflight and merge-plan files retain their original timestamps/statuses; they are not a fresh lease for a future live insight update.
liveDriftAndCompatibility.mainPublicationBoundary: The frozen readonly receipt distinguishes actual 8ff E2B cleanup success, ba mainChanged, and b56 Web READY. It is not evidence of this candidate model or Native performance acceptance.

green.includes: after-microtask scope reset, stale inflight response, max16, locale, same ordinary codec, one exact unknown-action fallback, no other retry; later live refresh remains fresh

readWaveSourceOnly.benchmarkBoundary: 500 alternating CPU-only scheduling pairs; no HTTP/DB/UI/model/Native latency claim. The new source cannot retroactively change ad8 failure.

correctedPayloadSupplement.reason: The observed 316483 value is raw string UTF-16 code units, not UTF-8 bytes. The corrected source receipt preserves this measurement boundary.
correctedPayloadSupplement.originalPrivacyReceiptPreserved: privacy-review.json describes the previous snapshot; this supplement binds the only corrected payload and its fresh privacy check.

verification.remoteReadback: not performed before root approval; must verify every path at the immutable new commit after publication

explicitExclusions: raw private CI or runtime logs
